name: bme280test

expect.contains:
BME280 test
-- Default Test --

Temperature = 21.37 °C
Pressure = 1009.82 hPa
Approx. Altitude = 28.60 m
Humidity = 43.60 %

Temperature = 21.37 °C
Pressure = 1009.82 hPa
Approx. Altitude = 28.60 m
Humidity = 43.60 %

Temperature = 30.05 °C
Pressure = 955.40 hPa
Approx. Altitude = 493.17 m
Humidity = 71.20 %

description: Adafruit's bme280test, unmodified: the library finds chip ID 0x60 at 0x77, soft-resets the part, waits out im_update, reads the trimming parameters and sets normal mode at x16 oversampling (a measurement every 98.5 ms), then prints each second. The raw values the part produces compensate, through the library's own formulas, to the room's 21.37 C, 1009.82 hPa and 43.6 %RH (28.60 m by the library's altitude formula); after the weather turns at 1.5 s, to 30.05 C, 955.40 hPa (493.17 m) and 71.2 %RH.
